composition_constraints.rule: Responses strict output uses text.format; Chat uses response_format. Do not exchange them.
Recursive JSON schemas are rejected. Flatten workflows into a fixed-depth DAG representation.
tool_search and json_schema cannot be in the same request. Discover/execute first; validate a strict final result on another turn.
Tool search is Responses or Messages only, exactly one tool_search with at least one deferred tool. Deferred functions belong inside namespaces.
Function names match ^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$ and have at most one dot. Namespace names contain zero dots.
Muse Wonder and Spark reject none. Minimal is the shortest supported pass. max is only Wonder 1.0 and standard Spark 1.3, not 1.3 Contributor. Reasoning is within billed output.

For stateless Responses loops use store:false and include:[reasoning.encrypted_content]; replay intact reasoning items with summary:[] and encrypted_content. Do not combine this include with previous_response_id.
previous_response_id carries conversation history, not current instructions/tools/reasoning options. Resend request-level controls.
Stateless function_call_output.call_id must pair with a function_call in the retained input. Preserve message ordering and commentary phase before tool calls.
max_tool_calls limits built-in tool calls, not the application total of client tool rounds or spawned agents. Enforce separate application bounds.

responses/input_tokens measures reconstructed context; generated usage.input_tokens may sum iterations and differ. Do not use context count as an invoice or final cumulative-usage count as current context occupancy.
HTTP 200 or stream connection success does not prove a completed result. Check terminal completion, errors, valid output, usage and independent acceptance checks.
SAM output_text is a custom geometry grammar, not arbitrary prose or generic JSON. Muse Voice only transcribes, never synthesizes speech.

cache_layers.description: Recompute cheap typed checks or reuse a version-bound verified artifact reference; this is not an LLM response-cache service.

Application sends an explicit cache key binding tenant/identity/policy/model/schema/input/evidence version. Request direct lookup, distinguish replayed usage from new upstream usage. Existing Qdrant-backed cache is preserved.

verification.warning: The recorded direct hit replayed an incomplete invalid answer. Cache-hit proof is not output-quality proof or cross-identity isolation proof.
verification.responses_policy: compatibility adapter requests x-bf-cache-no-store:true; this prevents new writes, not old reads

cache_layers.description: Automatic stable-prefix reuse. cached_tokens is a subset of input, billed at reduced rate, independent of store:false. Stable prefixes first; volatile input last. Optional prompt_cache_key groups compatible prefixes.

accounting.physical_energy: not collected or required; no physical-energy claim
accounting.forecast_warning: No cache hit, retry refund, deterministic completion, or universal minimum cost is assumed.

proof_loop.revision_rule: A rejected claim produces a changed candidate or a stated blocker, not an unchanged retry loop. Preserve all failures.
proof_loop.truth_boundary: Model confidence is not calibrated probability or proof. A finite successful experiment does not establish universal correctness. Deterministic policy/schema guarantees require enforcement and scoped adversarial tests.
